verdict: DEAD at gate 0 (pre-registered): the cap-pole lens closes. A: hub 2 0.04 in band, follow 0.85, frozen 76.59. B: 270 kinematic, frozen 47.76. C (best proxy, searched 344 tries, converged): frozen exact Bench(110,360) 32.08 / held 35.16 at 247 real-model takes (< 279), ib14 0.823, 9 contacts - +1.49 frozen / +1.13 held WORSE than the lead seats in the same paired kit at equal search effort (30.59 / 34.03); its two-lobe drive does not exist. The cap seat has no kinematic surplus over the lead knuckle: the lead seats/law take 277/360 kinematically in the same instrument (C 275, B 270); only A (294) clears 279 and it loses hub 2.
limiter: fold 85 (= the control 86) + link 2 x neck part collisions (19 bench / 53 held vs control 0 / 3): with J3 up the arm (d3 ~100) the neck to BOTTOM starts high on the lateral arm and link 2 sweeps across it under axial rotation (per-pair K6: link2 x neck is the only colliding pair; link 2 over hub K changes nothing). The box holds up to 299 kinematic takes, but the metal search walks back to ~275 (a stream from the 299 config ended at 29.5 near-touch).
note: Paired fold-ceiling kit (docs/research/fold_ceiling/kit_paired.py) with the K law per cell, m = 5 + 0.23 deg K play inside the fold margin; q 0.97 (the judge control setting; q 1.0 puts the cap J3 ray on the neck: hub 3 / link 2 150-250 mm out, 98.76). Control reproduces the judge (26.24 vs 26.27 fast). Kit omits drive metal and cuff knee in both arms: compare paired only. Selection of C2 among 3 stream bests was on frozen exact (34.25 / 32.08 / 32.73), so held 35.16 is the claim.
